title: Separated morphisms are stable under base change (Stacks 01KU (3))
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:S'\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $f':X'=X\times_SS'\to S'$ be the second projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $f$ is separated, i.e. its diagonal $X\to X\times_SX$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], then $f'$ is separated.
